factual_technical_accuracy.rationale: Print perfection and cost claims poorly substantiated

semantic_information_value.rationale: Broad creative ideation; modest specification depth

b2b_commercial_relevance.rationale: SMB use cases but broad consumer blend

executive_summary.strengths: Delivers a numbered list of 15 designs, separates holiday and everyday uses, and offers DIY versus professional ordering comparison.
executive_summary.critical_findings: Several awkward phrases and typos, overly assured print consistency and cost claims, scant specifications for artwork and holes/string/finishing.
executive_summary.recommended_corrections: Correct editorial errors; qualify manufacturer outcomes and bulk-price claims; add stock weight, hole diameter/location, string, dieline, print bleed and proofing guidance.
